title: Adding Temperature to the Adiabatic Connection: Hybrid Functionals for Static and Dynamic Correlation
summary: Capturing static and dynamic electron correlation simultaneously at manageable computational cost remains a key challenge in electronic structure theory. Motivated by the recurring role of effective temperature in self-consistent field methods we extend the adiabatic connection mechanism from density functional theory to include a temperature dimension.
